title: Platinum Account: How is interest calculated and when is it paid?
summary: This document explains Platinum Account interest: earnings use a 6.5% APY, compounded daily by converting the APY to a daily rate applied to your end-of-day balance and adding accrued interest at each compounding interval. Interest is credited monthly as a separate entry showing the total accrued amount for the period.
